referenceSources.title: ECR - Porsche 944 Turbo Cup details
referenceSources.description:
A pristine white Porsche 944 Turbo Cup race car, numbered 24, stands in a minimalist indoor display area. Sponsor logos from Blaupunkt, Dunlop, Bosch, Bilstein, and Shell adorn its sleek body, emphasizing its motorsport heritage. The car’s aerodynamic lines, pop-up headlights, and rear spoiler underscore its design for competitive racing.

This vehicle is cataloged on Exclusive Car Registry’s Porsche 944 Turbo Cup details page, originating from Würzburg, Bavaria, Germany. The registry entry highlights the car’s historical significance and preservation, situating it within a broader context of racing events, collections, and museum exhibitions.
